preheader: Goldman flags broader market risk, GTA VI sets records, and Nadal joins Real Madrid's board.

lead.headline: Goldman Sachs warns AI sell-off has widened into broader growth fears
lead.body: Goldman Sachs reported that Wall Street's tech slump has expanded from an AI unwind into a broader downgrade of economic growth expectations. Mutual funds and ETFs remain heavily exposed even after hedge funds trimmed positions. Anthropic's public debut was not enough to halt the slide as tech suffered its worst week since 2020.
lead.why: This shift shows the market drop is spreading beyond software hype into standard industrial and consumer firms. Watch how non-tech earnings hold up when planning long-term portfolio entries.

stories.headline: American Airlines retires long-haul first class to expand business suites
stories.body: American Airlines completed its last flight featuring an eight-suite first-class section this week. The airline is replacing those cabins with larger business-class layouts that hold up to 70 premium passengers.
stories.why: This is a clean case study in airline unit economics, showing how carriers trade ultra-luxury perks for high-volume, premium business travel.

stories.headline: GTA VI sets entertainment record with $3.79 billion opening day
stories.body: Rockstar Games announced Grand Theft Auto VI brought in $3.79 billion during its first 24 hours on sale. The total marks the largest launch in entertainment history, topping major Hollywood theatrical runs.
stories.why: It shows the sheer commercial scale of video game software relative to traditional media, useful context for media and consumer tech case competitions.

stories.headline: School districts push back as Google ties Search access to AI
stories.body: Major school districts in Chicago, New York, and Los Angeles are resisting Google after the company required schools to accept AI Overviews to keep using its search engine. The dispute follows Google's earlier decision to disable Gemini tools for student accounts.
stories.why: Enterprise software sales often hit walls when vendors try to force AI adoption on institutional clients. It is a key dynamic to watch if you plan to work in tech strategy.

stories.headline: Flaw in Meta Muse allowed web pages to access private user data
stories.body: Security researchers found a vulnerability where a single malicious webpage could pull private chats and saved memories from Meta Muse without prompting the user. Security firm NebuSec confirmed the exploit has been patched.
stories.why: As generative assistants handle private enterprise data, security reviews will be a central part of any IT consulting advisory engagement.

stories.headline: BCG report projects $1.2 trillion Indian capital goods boom by 2047
stories.body: A report from the Confederation of Indian Industry and Boston Consulting Group projects India's capital goods sector could reach $1.2 trillion by 2047. The expansion is backed by heavy spending on data centers, semiconductors, and clean energy.
stories.why: Consulting firms frequently structure hiring and project staffing around major global capital expenditure waves like this one.

stories.headline: Tech employers cut generalist roles in favor of specialized AI staff
stories.body: Nearly 90% of surveyed Indian tech employers plan to grow their AI teams, but most also anticipate cutting total headcounts. Companies are focusing recruiting budgets on specialized talent rather than broad entry-level positions.
stories.why: For campus recruiting, having tangible technical skills in data modeling or specific business analytics tools matters much more than generalist business coursework.

stories.headline: UC Irvine men's basketball drops first game of season at Stanford
stories.body: The Anteaters moved to 3-1 after falling 65-61 to Stanford on the road. UC Irvine held the lead for most of the contest before Stanford closed the game on an 8-0 run in the final 2:33.

stories.headline: Rafael Nadal joins Real Madrid's board of directors
stories.body: Rafael Nadal received formal approval to join the board of directors at Spanish soccer giant Real Madrid. The appointment pairs the tennis legend with club president Florentino Perez as the organization unlocks 1.25 billion euros in resources.

term.name: Market Correction
term.definition: A market correction occurs when a major index falls 10% or more from a recent high. Financial markets view corrections as standard resets that bring stretched asset valuations back in line with fundamentals.

serve.headline: Bharat Semi raises $24 million seed round for semiconductor infrastructure
serve.body: Hardware startup Bharat Semi secured a $24 million seed round to develop local semiconductor manufacturing and automation systems. The funding comes as global investors channel capital toward domestic chip supply chains.
